# netbox_wireless_lan_group (Resource)



> A Wireless LAN Group is used to organize wireless LANs into a recursive hierarchy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_wireless_lan_group" "parent" {
  name = "campus"
}

resource "netbox_wireless_lan_group" "child" {
  name      = "building-a"
  parent_id = netbox_wireless_lan_group.parent.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the wireless lan group.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the wireless lan group.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the wireless lan group.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the wireless lan group. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the wireless lan group.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the wireless lan group.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_wireless_lan_group.example 1
```
